verdict.rationale: Smithery offered a REST API, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. However, no evidence documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The only related item is a shutdown notice saying the API, CLI and SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026, with current versions marked deprecated; that is an end-of-service announcement, not a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
